title: Peach Blossom Pact
body:
Event period
November 26, 2026, after official launch – December 17, 2026, at 4:59 (UTC+9).

Observation details
During the event, the limited-time 5-star character Tushan Xiaoyu (Assault · Wind & Light) can be obtained through Peach Blossom Pact.

The drop rates of the 4-star characters Maple (Amplification · Light & Wood) and Anais (Support · Light & Earth) will be significantly increased.

Peach Blossom Pact is a Star Strings Observation. The guaranteed 5-star character counter is shared between Observations of the same type and carries over to future Star Strings Observations. This counter is not shared with other Observation types.

For more information, please check Observation Details in the game.

title: Launch gift and download issues
body:
Dear Starborn,

Thank you for playing Azur Promilia.

Since the official launch, many Starborn have been enjoying their adventures across the continent of Promilia. The entire operations team sincerely appreciates your support.

As a token of our gratitude, we are giving away Glittering Trace ×10. Please log in and claim your rewards through the in-game mail system.

Availability: Until maintenance begins on January 5, 2027.

Eligibility: Start playing the game and unlock the mail feature before maintenance begins on January 5, 2027.

Mail expiration: 30 days.

We would also like to provide an update regarding the current gameplay experience.

Some players have reported difficulties downloading and updating game data. We have identified issues where large data downloads or unstable network connections may cause lengthy downloads and data verification, stalled progress, or repeated data verification loops on the login screen.

We take these issues and all player feedback seriously and will continue implementing improvements gradually.

We sincerely thank everyone for their continued support and assistance in investigating these issues.

The Azur Promilia Operations Team

title: Yostar ID linking rewards
body:
Dear Starborn,

You can link your Azur Promilia account to your Yostar ID.

Complete the account linking process for the first time to receive Pure Trace ×1 as a reward!

Open the link in the in-game announcement to go to the event website.

title: Bonds Sworn Beneath Blossoms
body:
Event period
November 26, 2026, after official launch – January 5, 2027, at 4:59 (UTC+9).

Unlock requirements
Complete Main Story Chapter 1: The Looming Shadow.

Event details
During the event, help Tushan Xiaoyu develop her Spiritual Power, Courage, Bonds, and Insight through training. Experience various encounters alongside Xiaoyu and defeat the mastermind disrupting the bonds between the people of Fleece.

Your training choices will determine which ending you reach. Earn rewards based on your trial scores.

Event rewards
A Calm Day (4-star Anima), Pure Traces, Secret Rainbow Crystals, Flowing Light Fragments, and more.

Flowing Light Fragments can be exchanged for rewards at the Starlight Exchange.

For more information, please check Event Details in the game.

title: Beginner Observation: Primal Observation
body:
Availability
Available from November 26, 2026, after official launch.

Observation details
Use Pure Traces to perform Observations. Every 10 Observations guarantee at least one 4-star or higher character or Anima. At least one 5-star character is guaranteed within 30 Observations.

Primal Observation is only available in batches of 10 Observations, with each batch costing 8 Pure Traces.

Primal Observation ends after a total of 30 Observations have been performed.

For more information, please check Observation Details in the game.

title: Sprouting Journey
body:
Availability
Available from November 26, 2026, after official launch.

Unlock requirements
Progress through Main Story Chapter 1: First Time in Sprout Valley until you complete Proceed.

Event details
Complete the following main story quests to claim their respective rewards: Guidance of the Wolf, The Garden of Forest and Mist, Starlight for You, and Beneath the Dark Storm Clouds.

Event rewards
Pure Trace ×40 in total.

title: Little Hero
body:
Availability
Available from November 26, 2026, after official launch.

Unlock requirements
Progress through Main Story Chapter 1: First Time in Sprout Valley until you complete Proceed.

Event details
After the event begins, one set of missions will unlock each day, for a total of seven sets.

Earn rewards based on the total number of missions completed.

Event rewards
Peipei (5-star character · Burst · Earth & Light), In Training (5-star Anima · Burst), Peipei – Whispering Bamboo Retreat, Pure Traces, and more.

For more information, please check Event Details in the game.

title: Chasing the Evening Mist
body:
Availability

Unlock requirements

Event details
Clear Ring of Genesis VII in Echoes of the Heavenly Way with a 3-star rating to obtain the 4-star character Han Youyou (Amplification · Fire & Wood).
